hero_journey.cluster_name: 15q11–q13 imprinting: shared assays, distinct therapeutic directions
hero_journey.family_explanation: Angelman syndrome can leave a key brain-cell protein, UBE3A, missing or reduced. Another community studies how nearby genes are switched on depending on which parent they came from. Their published cell-model work offers a starting point for sharing research methods, not medicines.

counterexample.explanation: A shared gene name is not a shared intervention direction. A restoration effect aligned with UBE3A deficiency should not be transferred to a dosage-gain context.
counterexample.distinction: Not included in the UBE3A-restoration therapeutic cluster. Broader Dup15q is multigenic; this is a direction counterexample, not a treatment model.

collaboration.title: Co-design an imprinting-model validation brief
collaboration.action: Prepare a joint question for the Angelman and Prader-Willi research communities: can the published paired iPSC approach validate allele-specific expression and preserve neighboring imprinted transcripts?
deliverables: Agree genotype and imprinting quality-control criteria
Compare allele-specific expression and neighboring transcripts
Define a functional-rescue readout and early-kill threshold
Confirm model access and ethics before any experiment
collaboration.limitation: No collaborator has agreed, no cell access is secured, and no outreach is sent by this app.

acceleration.label: 10x acceleration hypothesis — not a measured result

atlas: Export a falsifiable shared research brief
acceleration.assumption: Sources and relationships are already curated and cached. The workflow may reduce repeated navigation; curation, biological validation and collaboration still take work.
acceleration.measurement_plan: A future paired task study should measure time and decision quality to produce a cited research brief against manual review. No ratio or precise time saving is claimed.

source_policy.literature: PubMed / PMC indexed publications; no journal allowlist and no journal-prestige weighting.
source_policy.biology: OMIM identifiers, ClinVar classifications, HPO terms and MONDO disease identifiers with explicit mapping scope.
source_policy.trials: ClinicalTrials.gov records with dated status; target enrolment is distinct from analysed sample.
source_policy.research_programmes: NIH RePORTER public programme/investigator records; funding aims are not study results.
source_policy.patient_resources: NORD, Orphanet, Global Genes, EURORDIS and verified official disease-group sites; no inferred partnership or registry access.
source_policy.supplemental: NLM MedlinePlus / GeneReviews disease references and DailyMed regulatory warnings remain explicitly identified.
source_policy.ovid: No Ovid dependency, institutional login or journal-restricted ingestion.
source_policy.metadata_limits: Unknown metadata and assay-specific sample sizes remain explicit; no sample-size or journal-prestige score is used.
